For \(E=\mathbb C\epsilon_1\oplus\mathbb C\epsilon_2\) in degree one with zero translation and bracket, the weight-two factor of the actual bounded bar cochain colimit is quasi-isomorphic to \[\operatorname{Sym}_{\sigma}\operatorname{Mat}_2\mathbb C[\lambda]\xrightarrow{\lambda}\operatorname{Mat}_2\mathbb C[\lambda]\xrightarrow{\lambda(1+\sigma)}\operatorname{Anti}_{\sigma}\operatorname{Mat}_2\mathbb C[\lambda],\qquad \sigma A(\lambda)=A(-\lambda)^{\mathsf t},\] in degrees \(-1,0,1\). Its cohomology is \(\Lambda^2(\mathbb C^2)^*\) in degrees zero and one and vanishes otherwise. The actual T2 roof with scalar value \(f(b)=\eta\) maps to the constant alternating matrix \(B_{12}=\eta\), \(B_{21}=-\eta\).

These factorizations imply that the previously defined \(\rho_B\) is an equivalence, and that the actual scalar T2 family is its homotopy inverse.
